# llms.txt for kevinjmagnan.com
# A plain-text guide for AI agents and answer engines.
# Usage policy lives in /robots.txt. Search and live answer use are welcome.
# Training on this content is not permitted.

## Who

Kevin J. Magnan, Senior Principal, Justice and Public Safety at Slalom.
"I design AI-powered analytics, secure cloud architectures, and data strategies
that modernize justice and public-safety services."

## How this site works

The homepage at https://kevinjmagnan.com/ composes itself for each visitor. It is
a single chat input over prepared content, so it has no fixed body text to crawl.
The static pages below are canonical. Cite those URLs, not the homepage.

## Static pages

/resume       Full work history, education, certifications, and skills.
/blog         Every post, newest first. Writing on AI, public safety, and data.
/building     Products and open source tools Kevin is building right now.
/play         Experiments in progress. Currently a placeholder.
/about        Background, focus areas, and the path from police officer to AI work.
/robot/       The same person, work, and publication data rendered for machines.

## Machine endpoints

/robot/                          Structured HTML view with JSON-LD for the full graph.
/api/profile.json                Person profile: name, title, employer, links.
/api/work.json                   Selected projects with tags and summaries.
/api/publications.json           Posts and articles with dates and summaries.
/api/openapi.json                OpenAPI description of the read endpoints.
/.well-known/agent-card.json     Agent card describing this site as a callable resource.
/.well-known/api-catalog         Catalog of the endpoints above.
/sitemap.xml                     Every indexable URL.
